doc.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Birthday club with Ruby Braff, James Williams and Billy Childs
summary: Hyman jokes about shared birthdays at age 74.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Now that I’ve reached the mature age of 74. Ruby’s [Braff] birthday and mine are very close you know, and a few people are, I was very touched last year when James Williams and what’s his name Childs, the other pianist.

Billy Childs. They called me up together and wished me a happy birthday and informed me that their birthdays are the same. This was very nice. At any rate so we’ve formed a birthday club and now they tell me that George Coleman is also a March 8.
Well you’re in good company then.
